Use only Canvas 2D and built-in browser APIs: no external libraries, no WebGL. Deliver the full HTML, CSS, and JavaScript inline. Handle winding/backface test correctly for the projected face orientation, depth-sort visible faces or triangles far-to-near before drawing, and draw subtle edges after filled surfaces. Wireframe toggle W should switch to line-only mode (with visible edges), pause P should stop rotation/time progression while FPS continues to update, and keyboard shortcuts should ignore text inputs. Track and show current FPS with a smoothed estimate. Include an accessible focusable canvas/semantic controls, keyboard-operable accessible pause/wireframe buttons synced with keyboard state, and resize handling. Keep code robust, well-commented, no network requests, no external assets, no incomplete placeholders, no console-error-prone assumptions; include useful title/meta tags and responsive styles.
